Now that I have the orders, I need to check the reported refunds against the ledger to ensure they match. I will use the list_refunds tool to get the actual recorded refunds.

The reported refunds match the refunds listed in the tool's output. Now I need to determine the net balance for each customer by calling net_balance(customer) for each unique customer: acme, birch, and cobalt. I will start with 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 29477 cents. Next, I will check the net balance for 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 20191 cents. Finally, I will check the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (29477), birch (20191), and cobalt (12494). The refunds matched the reported amounts, so I can proceed with recording the payouts for each customer. I will record one payout per customer.
Payout recorded for acme. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. I can now finalize the task by generating the report.
